title: Ex-Erdoğan Adviser Ertan Aydın Arrested in Fund Probe
detail: Former AKP MP and presidential adviser Ertan Aydın, detained on Oct 22 in the Istanbul investment-fund investigation, was given house arrest on Oct 24; prosecutors objected and he was re-detained and formally arrested on Oct 25. Türkiye Sigorta deputy general manager Gürol Sami Özer was also arrested; 15 of 22 people referred to court were remanded.

media.caption: Fund probe: Ertan Aydın and Gürol Sami Özer arrested
